Container.Name: Airbridge
Container.Overview:
Airbridge - Anything → Everywhere
Bridge DLNA/UPnP audio streams to AirPlay speakers. Use the web admin UI to discover AirPlay devices on your network and create virtual DLNA renderers that forward audio to them.
Perfect for streaming from Music Assistant, Plex, Roon, or any DLNA-compatible media server to AirPlay-only speakers like HomePods, Sonos, or Apple TVs.
Features: - Web-based admin interface for easy setup - Auto-discovery of AirPlay devices - Create and manage multiple bridges - Persistent configuration - Experimental Chromecast receiver support
Requires host network mode for device discovery.
